incident-bot: ALERT fired: latency.p99 EU-West > 3.5s for 5min, SLO burn 18% (auto-page)
vikram: ACKing, I'm on it. seeing p95 creep first then p99 spike.
maya: noticed a handful of long-seq requests in the top 10 callers, KV cache miss rate up ~22% vs baseline.
linh: dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inference/region/eu-west/latency — tokenizer coldstart events spiking at the same time
ash: can we divert write-heavy callers to the fallthrough model variant (gpt-small-q4)? will reduce quality but drop latency.
vikram: trying route override now — `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route/override -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"gpt-small-q4","ttl_sec":300}'`
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident P-48532 created, escalation to oncall-2 if unacked in 5m
maya: also bumping dedicated pool in eu-west: `infracli scale dedicated --pool inference-eu --count +2` — ETA ~60s
linh: temp rate-limit set for noisy clients (10 req/min) via edge rules. applied rule id r-893.
vikram: routing override accepted, seeing 30% of traffic shift. p99 dropped from 4.1s -> 2.6s on the canary slice.
maya: dedicated nodes started, but one node failing GPU init (OOM on model load) — rolling restart started.
ash: cache warmup job queued: `jobs/warmup_prefix --targets=top10callers --parallel=4` — kicking off now :rocket:
vikram: will follow up with customer-impact note. early check: error rate unchanged, but latency-sensitive endpoints improved after routing.
incident-bot: NOTE: keep thread for handoff. if p99 returns >3s after scaling+divert, escalate to eng-sre.
linh: leaving for lunch in 10. handoff to @vikram. TL;DR: spike driven by long sequences + KV cache miss; mitigations: route to smaller model, scale pool, warm cache, apply rate-limits.
vikram: oncall handoff @maya at 1795432550 — monitoring for 20m, next check in 10m. will produce short post-incident summary when stable.
